areas.t: Thursday, November 19: Mixing will gradually improve as an upper-level ridge shifts east. However, light southerly to southwesterly winds will continue to limit dispersion and carry regional pollutants into northeastern Ohio. These conditions will result in low-Moderate AQI levels.
